steps.en: Deploy the control plane onto a cluster that already runs Agent Substrate
steps.zh: 在已有 Agent Substrate 的集群上部署控制面

steps.en: Declare a Task, Workspace, Gateway and Model in one YAML file
steps.zh: 用一份 YAML 声明任务、工作区、网关和模型

steps.en: Stores the objects in Redis and provisions a Substrate actor
steps.zh: 把对象写入 Redis，并在 Substrate 上开出 actor

steps.en: Prepares git, MCP and skills in the sandbox, then starts your command
steps.zh: 在沙箱里备好 Git、MCP 和 skills，再启动你的命令

value.en: Agent tasks become YAML you apply — snapshots, routing and isolation stay under the floor, not in your manifests
value.zh: agent 任务变成一份 YAML：快照、路由和隔离仍由底层处理，不必写进清单

sources: https://github.com/google/ax/blob/main/README.md (make deploy AX_IMAGE_REPO=<your-registry>; ax apply -f examples/task.yaml; ax watch / ax ssh / ax suspend)
https://github.com/google/ax/blob/main/DESIGN.md (Redis hashes + streams; ax-server; ax-controller; Agent Substrate actors)
https://github.com/google/ax/blob/main/docs/sandbox.md (ax-task-runner as PID 1; workspace git/MCP/skills; optional goal via Antigravity)
https://github.com/google/ax/blob/main/examples/task.yaml (Task + Workspace + Gateway + Model in one file)
